records.question: How long does Spotify hold on to my personal information?
records.text: According to Section 6 of the Spotify Privacy Policy, Spotify keeps your personal data only as long as necessary to provide you with the Spotify Service and for Spotify's legitimate and essential business purposes, such as maintaining the performance of the Spotify Service, making data-driven business decisions, complying with legal obligations, and resolving disputes. [Spotify – 6. Data retention]

records.question: Will Spotify give my money back if I cancel partway through a subscription period?

records.question: How old do you need to be to open a Netflix account?
records.text: You must be at least 18 years of age to create a Netflix account or, where available, to become an Extra Member. [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service]

records.question: Can somebody who doesn't live with me use my Netflix plan?
records.text: According to [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service], "The Netflix service and any content accessed through it are for your personal, non-commercial use only and may not be shared with anyone outside of your household..." [Netflix – 1. The Netflix Service]

records.question: How long does Netflix hang on to my details?
records.text: We retain personal information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Privacy Statement, including to provide our service, administer and operate our business, and comply with law. [Netflix – Retention of Personal Information]

records.question: How long does Lyft store records of my past trips and payments?
records.text: At least seven years. [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information]
cited_labels: [Lyft – How We Store and Protect Your Information]

records.question: Will Lyft charge me if I book a ride and never turn up?
records.text: Yes, Lyft may charge a fee if you fail to show up after requesting a ride. [Lyft – Charges]

records.question: Can a 17 year old ride with Lyft?
records.text: Yes, a 17-year-old can ride with Lyft, but only if their parent or legal guardian has created a User account for them to use the Lyft Platform solely to access and use Lyft Services involving bikes and scooters, and the parent or guardian has ensured that the minor's use of the Lyft Platform is done in compliance with all applicable safety instructions and warnings. [Lyft – Eligibility]

records.question: Is Lyft making money by selling my data?
records.text: No, according to Lyft, "We do not sell your personal information to third parties for money–no one can buy the personal information we collect from and about you and we do not act as a data broker." [Lyft – How We Disclose Your Information]

records.question: Are kids allowed to have a Reddit account?

records.question: Will my paid Zoom plan keep billing me automatically?
records.text: Yes, according to Section 12.1, all Charges are recurring and will be charged to your Payment Method unless otherwise specified in an Order Form. [Zoom – 12. PAYMENTS AND CHARGES]

records.question: Can other people read my Zoom Email messages?
records.text: Yes, depending on the account owner's settings, account owners, or designated account administrators can access email content, including body text, subject line, attachments and custom labels applied to messages by users in their inboxes, even if those emails are encrypted. [Zoom – What Personal Data Do We Receive?]

records.question: Is Zoom allowed to shut down a service I'm paying for?
records.text: Yes, Zoom may terminate this Agreement, for any reason or no reason, upon thirty (30) business days’ advance notice. [Zoom – 14. TERM; TERMINATION AND SUSPENSION]

records.question: Do I give up my right to a jury if I have a dispute with Coursera?
